targets.query:
from(bucket: "ASTEP_Temperature_Chamber_Data_05-06-2026")
  |> range(start: -15s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "activity_grid")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "live_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.live_chip == "${live_chip}")
  |> group(columns: ["live_row", "live_col"])
  |> last()
  |> group()

  |> range(start: -15s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "activity_grid")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "live_value")

from(bucket: "ASTEP_Temperature_Chamber_Data_05-06-2026")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "activity_grid")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "live_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.live_chip == "${live_chip}")
  |> group(columns: ["live_row", "low_col"])
  |> last()
  |> group()

from(bucket: "ASTEP_Temperature_Chamber_Data_05-06-2026")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ToT_Point")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.Layer == "0" and r.Chip == "0")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        r with
        LocationInt: int(v: r.Location),
        IsColInt: int(v: r.IsCol)
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["LocationInt", "IsColInt", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["LocationInt","IsColInt"])
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> pivot(
    columnKey:["IsColInt"],
    rowKey:["LocationInt"],
    valueColumn:"_value"
  )
  |> group()
